pretreatments.description: Sterilization by autoclaving with 945 ml water at 121 °C for 30 min prior to enzymatic liquefaction.
Enzymatic liquefaction and saccharification of duckweed in four 2-L flasks using alpha-amylase, glucoamylase, and cellulase, followed by pH adjustment and saccharification at 50 °C.
Liquid hot water pretreatment in a 500 ml stainless steel Parr reactor using nitrogen pressurization to 150 °C.
